pkg_extractor (ShadPs4Plus PKG Extractor 1.1), used by the NBA LIVE 19 launcher's "PKG..." button
to unpack the game's PKG files.

Licence: GPL-2.0 (LICENSE-GPL-2.0.txt). It is built from code that used to be in shadPS4.
Source: https://github.com/AzaharPlus/shadPS4Plus/tree/PKG_EXTRACTOR_1_1 (folder "extractor")
Release: https://github.com/AzaharPlus/shadPS4Plus/releases/tag/PKG_EXTRACTOR_1_1
libc++.dll (LLVM, Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions) and zlib1.dll (zlib licence) come with it.
